title: After the Kikuka Sho: What's the Right Way?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Wooooo!

text_block_list.name: Caster
text_block_list.text: It's Mejiro McQueeeeen! She has conquered the Kikuka Sho!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: Thank you, everyone! Thank you for supporting me and the Mejiro family!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: I will walk proud as the Mejiro family's stayer!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: Now… I can finally… move on to where I… where I was meant… to go next…

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: Sniffle… Oh, I'm terribly sorry… I can't believe myself… Sniffle…

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: My goal for this year was to win this race. Thank you for your support, everyone! Now, and in the future!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Tears of joy run down her face. In the race of the three Mejiros, Mejiro McQueen has taken first.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Clap, clap, clap…

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: Did… did McQueen actually just cry in front of everyone? …

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: Hey, Ryan? McQueen's kinda, well…

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: She's got, like, a different vibe than usual, right? She had me shook since before the race even started.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: Yeah, she's pretty intense today.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: I gave 110% today too, but she was on a whole 'nother level.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: Yeah… Hey, Trainer…

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: Do you think that's the right way?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: Hm…

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: I mean happily shouldering the weight of the Mejiro name and running for victory. I think maybe…

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: Maybe that's what a Mejiro is supposed to do. Like, actually run races for real.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: (I ran as hard as I could, of course, but…)

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: (Did I really wanna win so bad that I would've cried if I didn't? I wonder…)

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: That night…

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: Hey, Trainer. I realized something after running in the Kikuka Sho today.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: I really am built a little different than the other Mejiros.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: Like… I feel like I don't have the same passion for racing. Or the same strength to dream big.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: Ryan ran all of the Classic Triple Crown races with a sense of duty to win every single one of them.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: And McQueen's attitude toward the race today was really amazing…

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: Then there's me. All I was thinking about was having fun.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: If you ask me if I was taking the race as seriously as them, well… I can't really say I was.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: I like running, but…

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: I don't know where exactly I should be running.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: Aaanyway, that just popped into my head! It's not like I'm seriously worried about where I belong or whatever.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: That's enough of that! Oh, right, you gonna eat that spicy pudding in the fridge? I've gotten kinda addicted to it.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Mejiro Palmer changes the subject and heads for the refrigerator. It seems she hasn't decided how she feels yet.
